methodology.timing: Public operation only; excludes module startup, setup, validation, window.close and explicit GC.
methodology.memory: Process memory after window.close, an event-loop turn and explicit GC. In this initial run the selectors workload could still retain its last NodeList; do not interpret those snapshots as a fully released DOM. Dedicated leak tests are saved in reports/memory.
methodology.compatibility: Assertions verify row count and decoded text outside timed regions; functional suites run separately.
methodology.ratio: jsdom median / rustdom median; values greater than 1 favor rustdom.
methodology.limitations: Synthetic workloads on one machine. Shared JavaScript DOM and selectors remain. No claim about complete test-suite speed.
